features.name: Add instructions during execution
features.value: Add a location, constraint, or correction while the assistant executes, without stopping first.
features.note: Current sending logic has no steer; it must bind expectedTurnId.

features.name: Model and reasoning-level selection
features.value: Choose a model and reasoning level in settings, beyond concise/detailed response style.
features.note: The phone read-only probe returned 7 catalog models; the other models were not individually tested for real generation. model and effort are separate parameters.

features.name: Necessary-information question cards
features.value: When route, account, time, or similar information is needed, show choices and return the user answer to the current task.
features.note: The current client returns -32601 to every server request. Ask only when required information is missing; do not add general confirmation gates.

features.name: Actual task steps and progress
features.value: Show steps, current stage, and failure location, improving on generic execution status alone.
features.note: Text streaming and generic tool status exist; plans and extended progress are not fully rendered. Model internal reasoning need not be exposed.

features.name: Structured phone tools
features.value: Expose app launch and foreground/background display observation and control as tools with parameter schemas.
features.note: dynamicTools is experimental; the current interactive-request handler rejects item/tool/call, and system operations mainly use runtime commands.

features.name: Context usage, quota, and compaction
features.value: Show context and quota status; provide native compaction when long conversations approach the limit.
features.note: New source already records tokenUsage; that module is not deployed on the phone, and quota/manual compaction have no entry. The read-only quota interface was verified.

features.name: Apps and MCP product entries
features.value: Show available connectors and tools, make connection state clear, and handle interactive requests.
features.note: The phone discovered codex_apps and 264 tool metadata records; generic mcpToolCall events are already displayed. Metadata count does not establish call acceptance or asset authorization for every tool.

features.name: Conversation branching, archiving, and search
features.value: Try another approach with the same context, organize history, and search/pin conversations.
features.note: The current list takes a fixed 100 entries, without complete pagination, search, or branching. Permanent deletion should be presented distinctly from archiving.

features.name: Native goal management
features.value: Store long-task objectives, status, and token budgets for continued work across turns.
features.note: Goal status is not scheduled wakeup; Android background survival and timed scheduling still need separate integration.

features.name: Realtime voice conversations
features.value: Speak directly after holding the power button and receive text or voice responses.
features.note: Experimental protocol from phone runtime 0.161.0; service availability, audio capture, playback, interruption, and power use were not verified. This does not establish integration with the general Realtime API.

features.name: Native task queue and multiple agents
features.value: Natively order pending tasks and show parent-child task relationships.
features.note: TaskBroker already has a queue. Before adopting the native queue, decide ownership of state to avoid two independent schedulers. multiAgentMode was not accepted on the phone.

features.name: Remote development and control
features.value: Observe and debug the phone runtime from authenticated clients without a USB cable.
features.note: The CLI supports remote connections; native remoteControl pairing is experimental. No network listener or remote channel was opened this round.

features.name: Development workbench
features.value: Develop code, run programs, inspect files, and review code on the phone.
features.note: Model-integrated command execution exists; these direct-control RPCs have no product entry yet. hooks/list is readable, with no hooks in the current working directory. review/start reviews code, not arbitrary phone-action acceptance.

features.name: Skills and Harness
features.value: Inspect/select skills, append device context when needed, and record usage.
features.note: Implemented in new source and settings entries; the phone APK is currently v43, and the installed broker matches the earlier hardware-acceptance SHA, without these new modules.

features.name: Plugin and marketplace management
features.value: Manage official plugin marketplaces and plugins together.
features.note: Official documentation explicitly marks some plugin methods as under development and says not to call them from production clients; existing Skills community installation is not the native plugin marketplace.

limits: RPC reference counts do not measure functional coverage; built-in model tools may execute without our own explicit RPC
Default export group includes some development-only APIs; it is not a blanket stability promise
Catalog metadata does not prove each model, connector or tool can successfully execute
Only read-only discovery and public protocol generation were run; no model turn, account change, compaction, archive or tool execution was triggered
